scope: Ordinary Cypher property ownership; public complete lifecycle and source-bound resource cost, not a speedup claim.
later_changes: e95a796c and 119d76ec update only cfg(test) route-projection assertions and two plan goldens; runtime implementation is unchanged from the frozen source.

environment.tmpfs_tmp: The separately tracked #1192 fixture hardcodes /tmp and fails admission; measured projects use private native-volume TMPDIRs.

protocol.freeze: Successful release compiler artifact copied to a private executable; SHA-256 checked before and after processes. No overlapping builds/tests during measurements.
protocol.timing: GNU time whole-process user/system CPU, elapsed time, max RSS and filesystem counters. Sampling and syscall tracing are separate runs; their timings are not latency evidence.
protocol.sampling: Requested 5ms, non-atomic recursive regular-file walk of the entire private TMPDIR; globally deduplicate (st_dev,st_ino), sum st_blocks*512. Includes coexisting source, retained generations, workspace temporaries, portable package and clean import. Excludes directories and unlinked open files; sampled peak is not a hard bound.
protocol.io: Successful read/pread/readv/preadv/write/pwrite/writev/pwritev/copy_file_range/sendfile returns across the tracee process tree, including non-file descriptors. Copy/sendfile contributes one read and one write. Does not count memory accesses or mapped-file page faults as syscall bytes. GNU filesystem counters are reported separately, without equating them to syscall bytes.

deterministic_budgets.scope: Owner probing and replacement-key reads only. Cumulative counters count repeated reads/items/batches again. Snapshot/decoder peaks are logical reader buffers, not full-publication memory or native RSS. Workspace admission and existing complete transaction costs are included only in whole-process observations.

For each named case, run /usr/bin/time -v FROZEN_EXECUTABLE --exact TEST --nocapture --test-threads=1 three times with separate private native TMPDIRs; rotate case order.

Run separate strace -f -qq -yy -s 0 -e trace=read,pread64,readv,preadv,write,pwrite64,writev,pwritev,copy_file_range,sendfile,fsync,fdatasync executions and sum successful return lengths. Retain unfinished/resumed and unparsed-result counts.
